name: Eschelbronn (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, with the municipal arms of Eschelbronn (blue and white lozenges and two crossed red staffs) in the upper hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Eschelbronn; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Eschelbronn arms — lozenges and crossed staffs
